NONE: A2 Online products, services, or information can be bought or used on the internet.
（產品、服務或信息）聯網的，在線的，網上的
A2 bought, used, etc. using the internet
從網上，在網上，利用網際網路（購買、獲得等）
› to be able to use email or the internet
上網際網路，在網際網路上
› connected to a system
（與系統）聯網地，聯機地

example: an online newspaper/magazine/dictionary
網上報紙／網絡雜誌／在線詞典
Do you like to shop online?
你希望在網路上購物嗎？
I'll send you my email address once I'm online.
我一上網就把我的電子郵箱地址發給你。
The new power station is expected to be online by July.
新發電站有望在7月份前實現聯網。
When will the new factory come online (= start production)?
新工廠何時開始生產？

NONE: › a bank that operates over the internet
網路銀行

example: You can use your smart TV to link to your online bank.
你可以透過你的智慧電視聯到你的網路銀行。

NONE: › the process or activity of managing bank accounts or operating as a bank over the internet
使用網路銀行；網路銀行服務

example: With online banking you can conveniently check your balance, transfer money, and pay bills using your smartphone.
有了網路銀行，你可以方便地用你的智慧手機查帳、轉帳和付款。

NONE: › a way of starting a romantic relationship on the internet, by giving information about yourself or replying to someone else's information
網路戀情

example: an online dating website
網路約會網站

NONE: › someone who watches something that is happening in a public place but is not involved in it
旁觀者，圍觀者

example: A crowd of curious onlookers soon gathered to see what was happening.
很快聚攏了一群好奇的圍觀者看發生了甚麼事。
Synonym
looker-on

NONE: A1 used to show that there is a single one or very few of something, or that there are no others
唯一的，僅有的
C2 used to show what is the single or main reason why something mentioned in the first part of the sentence cannot be performed or is not completely true
可是，但是；不過，只是
A1 used to show that something is limited to not more than, or is not anything other than, the people, things, amount, or activity stated
只，僅，才
B1 used to refer to something that happens almost immediately after something else
剛剛，才
› almost not
差點兒不；險些沒；剛好
B2 used to say that two related things are true or happened, especially when this is surprising or shocking
不但…而且
› If you say you have only (got) to do something, you mean that it is all you need to do in order to achieve something else.
只要，只需，儘管
› used when saying that something unpleasant will happen as a result of an action or a failure to act
（表示由於某個行動或未能採取行動而導致不好的事情發生）只，只會
› used to show that you feel sorry about something that cannot happen when explaining why it cannot happen
（表示遺憾）只能
B2 used to emphasize what you are hoping or wishing for
（強調你所希望或期待的）
› UK informal used to show that you think someone has done something silly
（表示認為某人做了傻事）不過，只是

example: I was the only person on the train.
我是火車上唯一的乘客。
Is this really the only way to do it?
這真的是做這件事唯一的方法嗎？
The only thing that matters is that the baby is healthy.
唯一要緊的是嬰兒身體健康。
It was the only thing I could do under the circumstances.
在這種情況下，這是我唯一能夠做的。
Rita was the only person to complain.
只有麗塔一人抱怨。
At present these televisions are only available in Japan.
目前這種電視機只有在日本才能買到。
Only Sue and Mark bothered to turn up for the meeting.
只有蘇和馬克當回事，出席了這次會議。
This club is for members only.
這家俱樂部只對會員開放。
Only an idiot would do that.
只有白癡才會做那樣的事。
Don't worry - it's only a scratch.
別擔心——只是擦破點皮而已。
I was only joking.
我不過是在開玩笑。
I was only trying to help.
我只不過想幫忙。
I only arrived half an hour ago.
我半小時前才到的。
She spoke to me only a few minutes ago on the phone.
她就在幾分鐘前和我通過電話。
It's only four o'clock and it's already getting dark.
才4點，天就開始黑了。
"Who's there?" "It's only me (= it is not someone you should worry about). I've locked myself out."
「誰在那裡？」「是我而已。我把自己關在外面了。」
It's only natural that you should worry about your children.
你擔心自己的孩子，這是很自然的事情。
People were leaving and I'd only just arrived.
人們都要離開了，而我才剛剛到。
We'd only just set off when the car broke down.
我們才剛剛出發，車就拋錨了。
There was only just enough food to go round.
食物剛剛夠每人一份。
We got there in time for our flight, but only just (= but we almost did not).
我們及時趕上了飛機，差一點就錯過了。
Not only did he turn up late, he also forgot his books.
他不但遲到，還忘了帶書。
If this project fails, it will affect not only our department, but also the whole organization.
如果這個企劃案失敗，不僅會影響到我們部門，還會影響整個機構。
If you want any help, you have only to ask.
如果你需要任何幫助，儘管開口。
You only have to look at her face to see that she's not well.
你只要看看她的臉色，就知道她不舒服。
If you don't do something about it now it will only get worse.
如果你現在不做點事的話，事情只會變得更糟。
I'd love to go to Australia. I only wish I could afford to.
我很想去澳大利亞。我只是希望自己能負擔得起就好了。
I only hope you know what you're doing.
我只是希望你知道自己在做什麼。
I only wish that they would keep in touch more regularly.
我希望他們能保持更密切的聯繫。
She's only locked herself out of her flat again!
她只是又一次把自己關在了公寓門外！
I'd invite Frances to the party, only (= but I will not because) I don't want her husband to come.
我本想邀請法蘭西斯參加派對，只是我不想她的丈夫也來，所以也就不邀請她了。
I'd call him myself, only (= but I cannot because) I'm at work all day.
我本要親自給他打電話，可是我一整天都在工作。
I'd be happy to do it for you, only (= but) don't expect it to be done before next week.
我很高興為你效勞，不過別指望能下星期前完成。
This fabric is similar to wool, only (= except that it is) cheaper.
這種布料跟毛料類似，只是價格更便宜。

NONE: › a child who has no sisters or brothers
獨生子（或女）
› to be interested in or attracted to only one person
只關注…；只對…感興趣

example: You've no need to be jealous. I only have eyes for you.
你沒必要吃醋，我只愛你一個。

NONE: › said when you mean that something you said was not intended to be serious
只是在開玩笑！

example: Think I'll leave you with the kids while I go for a beer - only joking!
想想我去喝啤酒而留下你和孩子在一起——開個玩笑而已！

NONE: C2 used to say that there are limits to something
（用於表示限度）這麼，那麼

example: There are only so many hours in your working day - you cannot possibly do all the work.
你上班就只有那麼時間，不可能什麼事情都做。

NONE: › used to show that something is surprising or unexpected
不料卻，沒想到卻

example: He spent months negotiating for a pay increase, only to resign from his job soon after he'd received it.
他花了很長時間協商要求提高工資，不料工資剛提高不久卻辭了職。

NONE: › UK also (only) time can tell used to say that the truth or a result will only be known in the future after events have happened
（只有）時間能證明

example: Only time will tell whether we made the right decision.
只有時間才能證明我們的決定是否正確。
